notes: Found by the sprint review (2026-10-24): kb/public/_answers.md QG32 line 'recognizer/version drift between independent Presidio (or other) deployments, measurable today with presidio-evaluator's published precision/recall method [DOC S-gpnrqpjt, S2105]'. The evaluation page (https://presidio.dataprivacystack.org/evaluation/) and the presidio-research README state only that the tool evaluates Presidio as a system, an NER model or a recognizer for precision, recall and error analysis; neither says drift between deployments or versions is measured with it. TK-hxz47zul dropped only the gone id S2111 from this tag and left the claim DOC, so it contradicts the UNK lines it added at _answers.md QG30 and agents/shared-ner-service.md. Fix by rewording the clause to what the pages state or tagging it UNK/DER with a dated note; keep the tag of the second clause (detection-quality gaps against a fixed test set) as it is.
